question.text: For a client with HIGH tax bracket, which strategy is most tax-efficient?

answer.text: Buy-and-hold equity for long-term capital gains (LTCG)

explanation.text: The Logic: LTCG at 12.5% (post-Jul 2024) vs slab rate on short-term trades. Buy-and-hold preserves after-tax wealth. The Trap: High-turnover triggers STCG (tax slab); high-dividend bonds fully taxable at slab. Cross-Exam Context: Topic 10 depth; Topic 9 application. Manager's Pro-Tip: Use tax-lot accounting to optimize capital gains realization — harvesting losses strategically.
